stages.label: Foundation
stages.blurb: Set up identity and tooling before starting the labs.

stages.label: Core loop
stages.blurb: Build the PR workflow used by the other challenges.

stages.label: Governed control plane
stages.blurb: Declare items, domains, labels, and access rules.

stages.label: Intelligent governance
stages.blurb: Apply governance to medallion, agents, observability, and promotion.

stages.label: Capstone & evolve
stages.blurb: Integrate the completed challenges and use feedback to improve them.

challenges.name: Setup
challenges.tagline: Set up the tenant, identity, and tools, then test the agent's Fabric connection.
challenges.outcome: Fabric tenant ready for RVAS, SPN federated to GitHub via OIDC, and MCP + Skills installed and verified.
challenges.value: Provisioning without client secrets, using reviewable identity configuration.

challenges.name: Workspace as Code
challenges.tagline: Create, update, and decommission workspaces through reviewed YAML manifests.
challenges.outcome: Workspace lifecycle managed through Pull Requests, with nightly drift checks.
challenges.value: A reviewable workspace lifecycle with checks for out-of-band changes.

challenges.name: Items as Code
challenges.tagline: Declare lakehouses, notebooks, and warehouses in item manifests.
challenges.outcome: Item manifests with per-kind naming, description, owner, and sensitivity rules. Validator + provisioner extended.
challenges.value: Check item ownership, column naming, and secret hygiene before merging a PR.

challenges.name: Domains, Capacities, Sensitivity
challenges.tagline: Validate each workspace's domain, capacity, and sensitivity label.
challenges.outcome: Domains and capacities as code; sensitivity labels applied at provision time; label-promotion review flow.
challenges.value: Support chargeback and Purview-aligned classification with region and capacity allow-lists.

challenges.name: Access & RBAC Lifecycle
challenges.tagline: Use group-first access, expiring assignments, JIT break-glass, and quarterly reviews.
challenges.outcome: Role assignments declared in access/; quarterly review workflow opens PRs; break-glass access recorded.
challenges.value: Review access changes in PRs and identify expired or unnecessary assignments.

challenges.name: Medallion Bootstrap
challenges.tagline: Scaffold Bronze / Silver / Gold lakehouses and their governance rules in one PR.
challenges.outcome: Per-tier sensitivity floors, endorsement, owners, schedules — produced by the e2e-medallion-architecture skill and captured back into manifests.
challenges.value: Reuse medallion templates with policy checks from the start.

challenges.name: Data Agent Governance
challenges.tagline: Build Q&A agents over allow-listed sources and lint their instructions for responsible AI.
challenges.outcome: Agent manifests gate data sources by sensitivity, RAI-lint catches refusal/scope gaps, drift detects out-of-band instruction edits.
challenges.value: Support self-service Q&A with source restrictions and instruction checks.

challenges.name: Audit & Observability
challenges.tagline: Collect governance events in Eventhouse, show them in Power BI, and configure Activator alerts.
challenges.outcome: KQL governance store, near-real-time ingestion of GitHub + Fabric activity, "Governance Health" dashboard, anomaly reflexes.
challenges.value: Track PR throughput, drift, and label coverage against governance SLOs.

challenges.name: Deployment Pipelines
challenges.tagline: dev → stg → prd promotion via Fabric pipelines, gated by PR labels and the same environment approval.
challenges.outcome: Pipelines as code; label-driven promotion; revert/prd rollback flow with a post-mortem PR.
challenges.value: Reviewable production releases with a defined rollback process.

challenges.name: Capstone — End-to-end integration
challenges.tagline: One PR (or short stacked series) exercises every challenge the team completed.
challenges.outcome: A realistic business scenario delivered through the governance plane, with artifacts demonstrated against the rubric.
challenges.value: Test the governance workflow end-to-end on the team's own data.
